name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on combating the sexual abuse and sexual exploitation of children and child sexual abuse material and replacing Council Framework Decision 2004/68/JHA (recast)
part_text: Member States shall take appropriate measures to ensure the prevention of child sexual abuse in all community settings and organisations whose staff and volunteers work in close contact with children, including schools, hospitals, day-care centres, social care services, sports clubs or religious communities.
